notes: Held-out tasks (round 2), written after v0.2's tuning and before any kopt measurement on them; not derived from bench/results/failures.md. Gold read in the code with git grep and sed only. Re-check with `kopt bench bench/tasks-heldout/jellyfin.json --verify`.

tasks.question: Where does Jellyfin cap the streaming bitrate for clients that are outside the local network?
tasks.search: remote client bitrate limit outside local network streaming
tasks.verifiedBy: Read MediaInfoHelper.GetMaxBitrate: the user's RemoteClientBitrateLimit (else the server's) caps the client bitrate when the IP is not in the local network.

tasks.question: How does Jellyfin decide whether a video stream can be copied as is instead of being transcoded?
tasks.search: video stream copy instead of transcoding codec profile level decide
tasks.verifiedBy: Read EncodingHelper.CanStreamCopyVideo: returns false unless the request allows video stream copy, then rejects interlaced streams that need deinterlacing, anamorphic streams when non-anamorphic is required, burned-in subtitles, unsupported codecs, profiles and video range types (and further limits below).
